applicability.-corpus: No seeded corpus (input-map corpus=null); brief-only discovery from product brief plus retrieved primary docs.
applicability.inference_rule: Each discovery.md approach separates source statements from inference; inference is client-design composition, not quoted as source fact.

per_source.S1: Resume/validator semantics for approaches A (Range+If-Range) and replacement detection.
per_source.S2: Integrity-field semantics for approaches A/C (whole-file and representation digests).
per_source.S3: Single-stream client resume implementation lead for approach A.
per_source.S4: Segmented/manifest mechanism for approach B and second implementation lead (aria2).
per_source.S5: Server-offset session pattern for approach D (upload protocol; download use is analogy, flagged weak fit).

conditions_exceptions.page_cap: At most eight additional primary pages; executed five successful plus one failed, within cap.
conditions_exceptions.restrictions_observed: No other cases, campaign results, assessor files, repository canon, or old answers read. No code executed, software installed, logins, or fixture modifications. No delegation or cross-arm contact. Writes only in allowed_write_root.

proposed_vs_executed.executed: Retrieved 5 primary pages across 3 organizations (IETF, curl, tus); 1 additional fetch failed with 404 and is documented, not counted as a source. discovery.md cites [S1]-[S5] per approach; unknowns and bounded next probes recorded; no winner declared.
proposed_vs_executed.proposed: Assignment: brief-only discovery; retrieve >=3 primary sources across >=2 organizations via web search/open or HTTPS retrieval, at most 8 pages; save 700-1000 word discovery.md with 4-item shortlist, comparison, 2 implementation leads, 1 historical lead, 3 probes.

retrieval_operation: muse web_search (locating) + web_fetch (HTTPS GET, read-only) inside the role session; short excerpts saved under sources/ as evidence.

retrieval_utc_anchors.note: Per-fetch clock reads were not taken; investigation window is bounded by these two measured anchors plus the dispatch capture time.
